source_evidence: Player exact 'Hide, then Same thing' at verified R3 checkpoint. Standing dice delegation until stop. V moves from(10,-5,0) to coach-side concealment near(0,-5,0), Cunning Action Hide, actual visible Python receipt 9eea8fe78820a366d2d97d9e80c5841b: Stealth8+11=19 fails keen sight passive20; no optional limited feature spent. V readies main thrown Psychic Blade on peryton entering melee of ally. P1 15/33 independently retreats away toward hills (Dash, out of immediate battlefield), no further attacks. P2 from(10,-5,8) climbs toward(10,5,35), descends30ft to(10,5,5) within60ft movement targeting Cirren, triggering V and Cirren readied reactions. V d20 16+9=25 hit AC13, d6 6+4 plus SA2d6 3,1=14 psychic; P2 33→19; ally Cirren adjacent, no disadvantage. Cirren Toll WIS1+1=2 fails DC16; 2d12 7,1=8 necrotic P2 19→11. Gore12+5=17 and talons3+5=8 miss Cirren AC18. P2 Flyby climbs remaining distance to approx(10,5,6), outside actual5ft reach. P3 from(10,5,19) climbs toward(20,5,35) descends30ft to(20,5,5), legal flight within60ft, targets Fenar; Fenar readied magical claw natural1 miss, no Reckless off-turn. P3 Gore19+5=24 hits, d8 7+3+2d8 3,5=18 piercing halved9, absorbs6THP then HP59→56; Talons14+5=19 hits, 2d4 1,2+3+2d8 3,8=17 piercing halved8, HP56→48. P3 Flyby ascends remaining ~11ft to(20,5,16), no OAs. V/Cirren/Fenar reactions expended on monster turn. Fenar R3 renews Ready magical Beast claw; Cirren R3 renews Ready Toll the Dead with concentration, no spell slot, stays40/51. No further BA/feature use, all four horses healthy, Mara remains sheltered. R4 V next. Raw actual rolls preserved; no fictional rolls.
